name: Ellalan
role: King of Anuradhapura from 205 to 161 BCE
contribution: A member of the Tamil Chola dynasty in Southern India, who upon capturing the throne became king of the Anuradhapura Kingdom, in present-day Sri Lanka, from 205 BCE to 161 BCE.

checks.lead: Ellalan (Tamil: எல்லாளன், romanised: Ellāḷaṉ; Sinhala: එළාර, romanised: Eḷāra; 235–161 BCE), also referred to as Elara the Pious, and by the honorific epithet Manu Needhi Cholan, was a member of the Tamil Chola dynasty in Southern India, who upon capturing the throne became king of the Anuradhapura Kingdom, in present-day Sri Lanka, from 205 BCE to 161 BCE.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
